blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction & Requirements

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解眼用製劑（Ophthalmic Products）的定義、給藥途徑分類，以及 USP 〈771〉 的適用範圍
blocks.en: Understand the definition of ophthalmic products, the classification by route of administration, and the scope of USP <771>

blocks.zh: 辨別各種眼用劑型（溶液、懸浮液、軟膏、凝膠、乳劑、條帶、注射劑、插入劑、植入劑）的特性與製造注意事項
blocks.en: Distinguish the characteristics and manufacturing considerations of the various ophthalmic dosage forms (solutions, suspensions, ointments, gels, emulsions, strips, injections, inserts, implants)

blocks.zh: 掌握眼用製劑的通用品質要求：無菌性（Sterility）、澄清度（Clarity）、微粒（Particulates）、pH、滲透壓（Osmolarity）及防腐劑（Preservatives）
blocks.en: Master the general quality requirements for ophthalmic products: sterility, clarity, particulates, pH, osmolarity and preservatives

blocks.zh: 理解藥-器械複合產品（Drug–Device Combination Products）在 USP 〈771〉 中的適用邊界
blocks.en: Understand where the boundary of USP <771> lies for drug-device combination products

blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Ophthalmic Products（眼用製劑）：所有用於眼部構造的無菌製劑，包括眼球表面及其周邊空間。「無菌」是眼用製劑最基本也最不可妥協的要求。
blocks.en: Ophthalmic products: all sterile preparations intended for use on the structures of the eye, including the surface of the eyeball and the spaces around it. Sterility is the most basic and least negotiable requirement for ophthalmic products.

blocks.zh: 三大給藥途徑分類：
blocks.en: Three classes of route of administration:

blocks.zh: 局部（Topical）：施用於眼瞼、結膜或角膜表面，最常見
blocks.en: Topical: applied to the eyelid, conjunctiva or cornea surface; the most common route

blocks.zh: 眼內注射（Intraocular）：穿透角膜或鞏膜等邊界組織，風險最高
blocks.en: Intraocular: penetrates boundary tissues such as the cornea or sclera; the highest risk

blocks.zh: 眼外注射（Extraocular）：注射至眼球周邊空間，如球後注射
blocks.en: Extraocular: injected into the spaces around the eyeball, such as retrobulbar injection

blocks.zh: 給藥途徑不同，微粒要求的嚴格程度也不同。眼內注射需額外符合 〈789〉 不可見微粒標準，因為玻璃體腔或前房幾乎無自我清除能力。
blocks.en: The stringency of the particulate requirements differs by route of administration. Intraocular injections must additionally meet the subvisible particulate standards of <789>, because the vitreous cavity and the anterior chamber have almost no ability to clear particles themselves.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像眼球就像一個密封的魚缸。局部點眼藥水只是把藥倒在魚缸蓋子上，藥物慢慢滲入；眼內注射則是直接把注射器插進魚缸。兩者對「水質（微粒清潔度）」的要求完全不同等級——魚缸內的水一旦引入雜質，魚（眼組織）立刻受損，根本無法靠換水（淚液沖洗）來補救。
blocks.en: Imagine the eye as a sealed fish tank. Instilling eye drops is like pouring the medicine onto the lid of the tank, and it seeps in slowly; an intraocular injection pushes the syringe straight into the tank. The two call for completely different levels of "water quality" (particulate cleanliness): once impurities enter the water in the tank, the fish (the ocular tissue) are harmed immediately, and there is no way to put it right by changing the water (flushing with tears).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: USP 〈771〉 的適用範圍是被動觸發的：只有當藥品專論（monograph）明確引用本章時，才全部或部分適用。這是 General Notices 3.10 的原則。製造商在撰寫新藥申請的品質規格時，可以參考本章提供的品質測試項目作為新藥專論草稿的基礎。
blocks.en: The scope of USP <771> is applied passively: it applies in whole or in part only when a drug product monograph explicitly refers to this chapter. This is the principle in General Notices 3.10. When writing the quality specifications for a new drug application, a manufacturer may use the quality tests provided in this chapter as a basis for a draft monograph for the new drug.

blocks.zh: 同時需要記住：效能測試（dissolution/drug release）不在本章範疇，另見 〈1771〉 Ophthalmic Products—Performance Tests。
blocks.en: Also remember that performance testing (dissolution/drug release) is outside the scope of this chapter; see <1771> Ophthalmic Products—Performance Tests.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼眼內注射製劑對亞可見微粒（subvisible particulates）的要求比局部點眼製劑嚴格得多？請從眼球解剖學角度說明。
blocks.en: Why are the requirements for subvisible particulates much stricter for intraocular injections than for topical eye drops? Explain from the standpoint of ocular anatomy.

blocks.zh: USP 〈771〉 是強制性章節（mandatory）還是選用性章節（guideline）？何時成為強制要求？
blocks.en: Is USP <771> a mandatory chapter or an optional (guideline) chapter? When does it become a mandatory requirement?

blocks.zh: Drug–Device Combination Products（藥-器械複合產品）
blocks.en: Drug–Device Combination Products

blocks.zh: 滅菌策略選擇的層次邏輯：眼用製劑滅菌三大路徑各有限制：
blocks.en: The tiered logic of choosing a sterilization strategy: each of the three sterilization routes for ophthalmic products has its limits:

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌（Autoclave）：溫度可能破壞懸浮液、半固態、乳劑等不耐熱劑型
blocks.en: Autoclave (steam sterilization): the temperature may damage heat-labile dosage forms such as suspensions, semi-solids and emulsions

blocks.zh: 過濾除菌（Filtration）：僅適用於微粒 <0.2 µm 的製劑，無法處理懸浮液或半固態
blocks.en: Filtration: applicable only to preparations whose particles are <0.2 µm; it cannot handle suspensions or semi-solids

blocks.zh: 無菌製造（Aseptic Manufacturing）：用無菌原料在受控環境中生產，為前兩者不可行時的替代方案
blocks.en: Aseptic manufacturing: production from sterile raw materials in a controlled environment; the alternative when the first two are not feasible

blocks.zh: 這三條路徑直接影響製造廠的設施投資與驗證策略，是 CDMO 接案時首要評估的技術節點。
blocks.en: These three routes directly affect a manufacturing site's facility investment and validation strategy, and are the first technical node a CDMO evaluates when taking on a project.

blocks.zh: 眼用劑型的藥物滯留時間就像不同類型的眼藥貼服方式：
blocks.en: The drug residence time of ophthalmic dosage forms can be compared to different ways of applying something to the eye:

blocks.zh: 溶液 = 噴水霧在玻璃上，很快流走
blocks.en: Solution = a water mist sprayed on glass, which runs off quickly

blocks.zh: 加黏度的溶液 = 塗蜂蜜，流速慢多了
blocks.en: Viscosity-enhanced solution = honey spread on the glass, which flows much more slowly

blocks.zh: in-situ 凝膠 = 倒入熔融果凍液，接觸眼睛就固化，大幅延長接觸時間
blocks.en: In-situ gel = molten jelly poured on, which solidifies on contact with the eye and greatly extends contact time

blocks.zh: 軟膏 = 凡士林，附著力最強，但會模糊視線
blocks.en: Ointment = petroleum jelly, which adheres best but blurs vision

blocks.zh: Insert（插入劑） = 緩釋膠囊放進結膜囊，12–24 小時慢慢溶解
blocks.en: Insert = a sustained-release capsule placed in the conjunctival sac, which dissolves slowly over 12–24 hours

blocks.zh: 每種劑型的「黏著力」不同，製造的無菌挑戰也不同。半固態製劑最難過濾除菌，只能靠無菌製造或原料預滅菌。
blocks.en: Each dosage form has a different degree of "stickiness", and the sterility challenges in manufacturing differ as well. Semi-solid preparations are the hardest to sterilize by filtration and can only rely on aseptic manufacturing or pre-sterilized raw materials.

blocks.zh: 多劑量產品（Multi-dose Products）的防腐劑規定：一旦開封、多次使用，就必須有效的抗菌防腐劑，或使用能維持無菌的包裝系統（如無防腐劑的特殊瓶塞設計）。防腐劑有效性需依 〈51〉 Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing 驗證，整個貨架壽命期間均需維持。
blocks.en: Preservative requirements for multi-dose products: once a product is opened and used repeatedly, it must have either an effective antimicrobial preservative or a packaging system that maintains sterility (such as a special closure design for preservative-free products). Preservative effectiveness must be demonstrated according to <51> Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing and maintained throughout the shelf life.

blocks.zh: 懸浮液的粒徑上限：藥物粒徑 <10 µm 是降低眼部刺激的關鍵門檻。粒徑過大會造成沙粒感，直接影響患者耐受性。這個數字在懸浮液配方開發時是硬性設計目標。
blocks.en: Upper limit of particle size in suspensions: a drug particle size of <10 µm is the key threshold for reducing ocular irritation. Oversized particles cause a gritty sensation and directly affect patient tolerability. This figure is a hard design target during suspension formulation development.

blocks.zh: 公式與關鍵數字 Key Numbers
blocks.en: Key Numbers

blocks.zh:
過濾除菌適用條件：微粒粒徑 < 0.2 µm
懸浮液藥物粒徑目標：< 10 µm（降低刺激）
眼用 Insert 溶解時間：12–24 小時（可溶型）
油膏：設計熔點 = 體溫（約 37°C）
blocks.en:
Condition for sterilizing filtration: particle size < 0.2 µm
Drug particle size target for suspensions: < 10 µm (to reduce irritation)
Dissolution time of an ophthalmic insert: 12–24 hours (soluble type)
Ointment: designed melting point = body temperature (about 37°C)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO 的製造科學家，當客戶帶來一個水難溶性眼科藥物時，你的選擇矩陣：
blocks.en: As a manufacturing scientist at a CDMO, when a client brings a poorly water-soluble ophthalmic drug, your option matrix is:

blocks.zh: 若能做成奈米懸浮液（<10 µm）→ 考慮眼用懸浮液，需驗證再分散性
blocks.en: If it can be made into a nanosuspension (<10 µm) → consider an ophthalmic suspension; redispersibility must be validated

blocks.zh: 若藥物光敏感 → 可能考慮藥-器械複合（光激活系統），但設備監管另循 FDA 醫療器械法規
blocks.en: If the drug is light-sensitive → a drug-device combination (light-activated system) may be considered, but the device is regulated separately under FDA medical device regulations

blocks.zh: 若需要長效局部作用 → Ocular Insert 或 Implant，但製程複雜度大幅增加
blocks.en: If long-acting local effect is needed → an ocular insert or implant, but process complexity increases substantially

blocks.zh: 所有路徑均需無菌製造評估：哪個 sterilization route 可行？
blocks.en: Every route requires an aseptic manufacturing assessment: which sterilization route is feasible?

blocks.zh: 某藥物不耐熱、分子量大無法過濾，應採用哪種滅菌策略？需要哪些額外驗證活動？
blocks.en: A drug is heat-labile and its molecular size is too large for filtration. Which sterilization strategy should be used, and what additional validation activities are needed?

blocks.zh: 藥-器械複合眼用產品中，「藥物劑型」與「器械」分別依循哪些法規要求？USP 〈771〉 管轄範圍在哪裡停止？
blocks.en: For a drug-device combination ophthalmic product, which regulatory requirements apply to the "dosage form" and to the "device" respectively? Where does the jurisdiction of USP <771> stop?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑涵蓋廣泛劑型（溶液至植入劑），共同要求是無菌性，且均受 USP 〈771〉 管轄（當藥品專論引用時）
blocks.en: Ophthalmic products cover a broad range of dosage forms (solutions through implants); their common requirement is sterility, and all are governed by USP <771> (when referenced by a drug product monograph)

blocks.zh: 給藥途徑三大分類（局部、眼內注射、眼外注射）決定微粒控制的嚴格程度階梯：眼內注射要求最嚴（需符合 〈789〉）
blocks.en: The three classes of route of administration (topical, intraocular, extraocular) set a stepped scale of particulate control stringency: intraocular injections are the strictest (they must meet <789>)

blocks.zh: 滅菌策略選擇受制於劑型特性：不耐熱製劑需轉向無菌製造，過濾僅適用溶液（<0.2 µm）
blocks.en: The choice of sterilization strategy is constrained by dosage form: heat-labile preparations must move to aseptic manufacturing, and filtration suits only solutions (<0.2 µm)

blocks.zh: 多劑量製劑必須有效防腐系統，藥-器械複合產品的器械部分不在 〈771〉 範疇內
blocks.en: Multi-dose preparations must have an effective preservative system; the device part of a drug-device combination product is outside the scope of <771>
